items.title: Adobe Commerce Template Engine Injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required even for new installations.

items.title: Adobe Commerce B2B Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization flaw (CVSS 9.8) in Adobe Commerce B2B could allow an unauthenticated attacker to achieve code execution. This was addressed as part of the APSB26-153 security update.

items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities, including Stored Cross-Site Scripting
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, with six exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200). Adobe recommends applying the September security update and the APSB26-146 hotfix in addition.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Template Engine RCE (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via a template engine flaw. Adobe is aware that this vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Incorrect Authorization (Customer Account Takeover)
items.summary: This update fixes a critical unauthenticated incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) that could lead to customer account takeover. This CVE has been added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Unrestricted File Upload (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) is an unrestricted file upload flaw that could lead to privilege escalation. Adobe provided isolated patch files for this issue.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Webhooks Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) affecting Adobe Commerce webhooks could lead to arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrative privileges.
